values.name: Shunsaku Kobayashi
values.bio: Shunsaku Kobayashi is a Japanese freediver from Nagano who specialises in depth. After nine years in Germany working as a fluid dynamics engineer, he moved to the island of Miyakojima in 2022, drawn by its ocean. He now competes as a professional freediver and teaches as an AIDA and Molchanovs instructor.
